sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थः प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया सह भार्यया ।। ६.१२३.३ ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu kākutsthaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā saha bhāryayā ।। 6.123.3 ।।

translations.english: Gratified by Mahendra's words, Raghava was very happy and pleased, submitting to him as follows.
